svg.title: The 2026 injectable glutathione outbreak, as the official record shows it
svg.desc: July 2026: Texas notifies CDC. August 5: Victory Medical Center Pharmacy recall. August 19: Optimal Balance Pharmacy recall. August 20: the ingredient supplier tells FDA it warned customers. August 27: FDA alert citing at least 30 patients and one dietary-supplement-grade ingredient lot. September 9: Centric Compounding recall. September 15: CDC update, more than 25 sick in at least 4 states, at least 3 hospitalized, all after IV doses. September 22: Minnesota health alert. October 1: Greenwich Rx recall. As of October 23 we found no newer FDA or CDC case count.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
